title: Design System: AirPods Pro 2 Examination Record

masthead.purpose: The product name at the head of the sheet. One per page, Archivo Narrow 700 uppercase.

grade.purpose: The verdict word, always sitting on a 3px rule that takes the verdict's colour.

subtitle.purpose: A ledger row's parameter name; the masthead standfirst.

body.purpose: All prose. Tabular lining figures on. Measures capped 46-82ch by content.

label.purpose: Section headings, uppercase Narrow in the register colour.

caption.purpose: Field keys, table heads, Source keys, row meta.

fine.purpose: The citation line under every finding, plot captions, register sources.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system has no elevation shadows. Depth is tonal: paper to recessed field to hatch.

shadows.name: hairline-outline
shadows.purpose: A stroke written in shadow syntax, on a de-emphasised panel cue. The only acceptable use of box-shadow.

motion.name: ease-sheet
motion.purpose: The only easing on the surface. Exponential ease-out.

motion.name: grade-strike
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: the grade word resolves out of blur and 0.16em tracking.

motion.name: strike-on
motion.purpose: Marks strike onto the sheet in ledger order.

motion.name: seg-in
motion.purpose: Coverage rail segments scale in from the left.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Opacity and colour transitions on cues, buttons, and the skip link.

components.name: Run Button
components.description: The single primary action: runs the examination. Ink fill, square, shifts to the register colour on hover.
components.css: .ds-run { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; color: var(--paper, #e9edef); background: var(--ink, #0d1417); border: 2px solid var(--ink, #0d1417); border-radius: 0; padding: 14px 32px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-run:hover { background: var(--intaglio, #0b6b4f); border-color: var(--intaglio, #0b6b4f); } .ds-run:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--intaglio, #0b6b4f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-run:disabled { background: none; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a5a63); border-color: var(--intaglio-hair, #b9cfc7); cursor: progress; }

components.name: State Marks
components.description: The three drawn state glyphs: pass tick, struck cross, dashed unresolved box. Every one reads with colour removed.
components.css: .ds-marks { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center; } .ds-mk { display: block; flex: none; } .ds-mk-box { fill: none; stroke-width: 1.4; } .ds-mk-glyph { fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: square; } .ds-mk-pass .ds-mk-box, .ds-mk-pass .ds-mk-glyph { stroke: var(--intaglio, #0b6b4f); } .ds-mk-fail .ds-mk-box, .ds-mk-fail .ds-mk-glyph { stroke: var(--struck, #c2371d); } .ds-mk-unknown .ds-mk-box { stroke: var(--ink-soft, #4a5a63); stroke-dasharray: 3 2.5; }

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: One graded check: index, state mark, parameter, tier and weight, the finding, and its cited source in fine print.
components.html:
1. 01

    Model Number Compatibility

    Tier 1 / weight 5.0, disqualifying

    Extracted model A2698 matches Pro 2 Lightning part.

    SourceApple, 'Identify your AirPods' (support.apple.com)
components.css: .ds-ledger { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 24px; color: var(--ink, #0d1417); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px 24px 1fr; gap: 0 12px; padding: 0 0 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--intaglio-hair, #b9cfc7); } .ds-row-n { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--intaglio, #0b6b4f); line-height: 24px; } .ds-row-mk { padding-top: 4px; } .ds-row-param { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.011em; line-height: 24px; } .ds-row-meta { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.15em; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a5a63); } .ds-sep { padding: 0 0.5em; color: var(--intaglio, #0b6b4f); } .ds-row-detail { margin: 0 0 8px; max-width: 68ch; line-height: 24px; } .ds-row-source { margin: 0; max-width: 72ch; font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 16px; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a5a63); } .ds-src-key { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-weight: 600; font-size: 9.5px; color: var(--intaglio, #0b6b4f); margin-right: 0.7em; }

components.name: Coverage Rail
components.description: One weighted segment per rule. Dashed outline = not run, solid intaglio fill = passed, vermilion diagonal stripe = failed. Never a percentage.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; gap: 3px; height: 16px; } .ds-seg { flex-basis: 0; border: 1px dashed var(--ink-soft, #4a5a63); background: transparent; border-radius: 0; } .ds-seg-pass { border: 1px solid var(--intaglio, #0b6b4f); background: var(--intaglio, #0b6b4f); } .ds-seg-fail { border: 1px solid var(--struck, #c2371d); background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--struck, #c2371d) 0 2px, transparent 2px 5px); }

components.name: Ruled Record Field
components.description: The read-only form field the whole sheet is built from: a caps key over a tabular value. Unfilled prints a dash pair, never a zero.
components.html:
Examination coverage
10.5of19.5evidence weight
Confidence in the finding
0.85
Variant
——
components.css: .ds-record { display: flex; gap: 0 40px; margin: 0; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #0d1417); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-record dt { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-weight: 600; font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a5a63); margin-bottom: 2px; } .ds-record dd { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 24px; } .ds-record b { font-weight: 700; } .ds-of { padding: 0 0.45em; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a5a63); } .ds-unit { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a5a63); padding-left: 0.5em; } .ds-unfilled { color: var(--ink-soft, #4a5a63); letter-spacing: -0.08em; }

components.name: Panel Cue
components.description: The plot's affordance. An unexposed panel wears its verb at rest because the meet-up phone has no hover; an exposed one goes ink and appears on hover or focus.
components.html: add photoreplaceadd photo
components.css: .ds-cues { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; } .ds-cue { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: var(--paper, #e9edef); background: var(--intaglio, #0b6b4f); padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 0; transition: opacity 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-cue-exposed { background: var(--ink, #0d1417); } .ds-cue-graded { background: none; color: var(--intaglio, #0b6b4f); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--intaglio, #0b6b4f); } .ds-cue:hover { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: The sheet's only heading furniture: narrow uppercase in the register colour, optionally over a 2px intaglio rule where a column begins.
components.css: .ds-section-h { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--intaglio, #0b6b4f); margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-rows-h { padding-top: 8px; border-top: 2px solid var(--intaglio, #0b6b4f); margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 16px; }

components.name: Failure Notice
components.description: The only boxed element on the sheet: a 2px vermilion outline around a blocking problem and its fix. Outline only, never a fill.
components.html:
The photograph could not be read.

Re-shoot the underside label square on, in daylight, close enough to fill the frame.
components.css: .ds-notice { padding: 16px 24px; border: 2px solid var(--struck, #c2371d); border-radius: 0; max-width: 62ch; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 24px; } .ds-notice-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin: 0 0 8px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--struck, #c2371d); } .ds-notice-fix { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a5a63); }

narrative.overview:
This surface is a document, not an app screen. It behaves like a printed examination record on cold security stock: a guilloche border traced by an actual geometric lathe, a masthead ruled off from the body, a plot of the specimen, graded rows with their sources in fine print, and a grader's seal that names who graded it. The buyer holding a phone over a stranger's box and the buyer at a desk reading listing photographs are looking at the same sheet at two widths, not at two products.

Density is high and deliberately unpadded. There are no cards, no panels, no containers, no rounded corners anywhere in the shipped stylesheet - the entire surface is one hard unit of paper, and its sections are separated by voids and by a small number of heavy printed rules. The ornament is real: the border, the underprint behind the grade, and the seal ring all come from one lathe function (guilloche.ts) tracing hypotrochoids on integer teeth so the curves close without a seam.

The refusals are structural. There is no drop-zone hero, no colour-coded score badge, and no authenticity percentage, because the pipeline behind the sheet does not produce one. Coverage and confidence are printed as two separate figures and never merged. State is carried by a struck mark - a tick, a crossed box, a dashed box - so every outcome survives colour being removed, and INCONCLUSIVE reads as an unfilled field rather than a failure.
keyCharacteristics: One hard modular unit (--u: 8px); every measure a whole multiple of it
Four colour roles only; vermilion reserved for struck FAIL marks
Zero corner radius, zero drop shadows, zero containers
Drawn ornament from a real lathe, never an image asset
State is a mark, never a hue
Tabular lining figures on globally, so numbers align down a column
One authored motion moment, guarded for reduced motion

rules.name: The Four Roles Rule
rules.body: Paper, ink, intaglio, struck. Nothing outside these four roles reaches the sheet. A new need is a tint of an existing role, not a tenth colour.

rules.name: The Strike Reserve Rule
rules.body: Vermilion appears only where a mark is struck through or a finding is disqualifying. It is never a fill, a background, a hover state, or an emphasis colour.

rules.name: The Colour-Removed Rule
rules.body: Every state must remain readable with colour stripped out. A tick, a crossed box, a dashed box, a solid versus dashed border, a hatched versus solid fill - the glyph or the stroke style carries the meaning and the hue only reinforces it.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Narrow is the printed apparatus - mastheads, grades, labels, keys, figures on the drawing, fine print. Regular is the reading voice. A third family is never introduced, and a system display face is never substituted for the self-hosted ones.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Figures are tabular and lining everywhere. Any new numeric readout inherits this; never disable it for a 'nicer' proportional set.

rules.name: The Uppercase Is Apparatus Rule
rules.body: Uppercase + wide tracking marks something as form furniture (a key, a heading, a stamp). It is never used on a sentence the buyer has to read.

rules.name: The Whole Unit Rule
rules.body: Every measure is calc(var(--u) * n) for a whole n. If a value cannot be expressed that way, the layout is wrong, not the unit.

rules.name: The Void Rule
rules.body: Sections are separated by space and by mass. A hairline between two sections is a failure to give them enough room; rules are reserved for the four places the sheet already uses them.

rules.name: The Pan-Don't-Shrink Rule
rules.body: A drawing whose type would become illegible at the phone's column width keeps its size and pans inside its own box (min-width: 560px in an overflow-x: auto figure). Shrinking to fit is not responsive, it is unreadable.

rules.name: The Printed-Flat Rule
rules.body: Nothing on this sheet floats. Depth comes from tone (paper to field to hatch) and from ink weight. No box-shadow for elevation, no hard offset shadow, no blur, ever.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: Radius is 0. Everywhere. A rounded corner on this sheet is a bug.

rules.name: The Drawn Ornament Rule
rules.body: Guilloche is generated by lib/guilloche.ts, never shipped as an image. Teeth must be integers or the curve leaves a seam; pen distance under the rolling radius gives petals, over it gives loops.

rules.name: The Two Figures Rule
rules.body: Coverage and confidence are printed as two labelled numbers, side by side, in the same size. They are never averaged, never combined into a score, and no authenticity percentage exists on this surface.

rules.name: The Unfilled Field Rule
rules.body: An empty record is a blank ruled form, not an error or an empty state illustration. Every check is already listed, the grade field is ruled and captioned 'Not yet graded', and the values print as dashes.

rules.name: The Motion Budget Rule
rules.body: One authored moment: on a fresh result, marks strike onto the sheet in ledger order (420ms, 55ms apart), the grade word resolves out of blur and wide tracking (grade-strike, 520ms), and the rail segments scale in - all on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), all cut to 1ms under prefers-reduced-motion. Everything else is a 140-180ms opacity or colour transition. No parallax, no scroll animation, no looping decoration.

dos: Do express every measure as calc(var(--u) * n) with a whole n; --u is 8px and it is the only rhythm on the sheet.
Do carry state with a drawn glyph and a stroke style first - tick, cross, dashed box, solid vs. dashed border, hatch vs. fill - and let colour only reinforce it.
Do keep vermilion for struck FAIL marks, the disqualifying grade word and its rule, and the failure notice border. Nothing else.
Do theme the browser's own surfaces from the palette: selection, scrollbar track and thumb, :focus-visible ring at 2px/3px offset, link underline offset at 3px. They are part of the printing.
Do keep tabular lining figures on for every numeric readout.
Do generate guilloche from lib/guilloche.ts with integer teeth so the curve closes; use rosette() for grounds, sealRing() for stamps, strip() for edges.
Do let a drawing pan inside its own overflow-x: auto box rather than shrink below legibility, and keep overscroll-behavior-x: contain on it.
Do give a primary action on a touch surface a cue that is visible at rest; hover-only affordances are invisible to half the audience.
Do print every finding's cited source in fine print directly beneath it.
Do keep the print stylesheet working: interactive furniture hides, the examination goes to two even columns, the border drops out.
donts: Don't add a border-radius. The radius scale has one value and it is 0.
Don't add a drop shadow, glow, or blur for elevation. Depth is tonal: paper to recessed field to hatch.
Don't merge coverage and confidence, or introduce an authenticity percentage, a score ring, or a colour-graded meter.
Don't style INCONCLUSIVE as a failure. It takes tinted ink and a dashed rule - the visual language of an unfilled field.
Don't use vermilion as a fill, a background, a hover, or an emphasis colour; a failed rail segment is striped precisely so it is never a flat block of it.
Don't introduce a fifth colour role, a third type family, a system display face, or an icon font. The three state glyphs and the hardware silhouettes are drawn paths at a declared stroke weight.
Don't ship guilloche as an image asset, and don't pass non-integer teeth to trace() - the curve will not close and the seam is visible.

Don't divide two sections with a hairline. Use a void. The only rules on the sheet are the masthead/colophon 2px ink lines, the 2px intaglio heading rules, the 3px grade rule, and the 1px register-hair row lines.
Don't plot a mark on a panel whose source photograph does not exist; plotPanel() returning null is a correctness guarantee, not an edge case.
Don't publish a whole serial number anywhere on the sheet.
Don't add a second animated moment. One strike, guarded for reduced motion, is the budget.
